tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic proposes a 50-death artificial intelligence safety threshold with judicial review to block high-risk models, confirmed by AndroGuider.
Amazon and Google launch open-source artificial intelligence tools to challenge Nvidia's artificial intelligence chip dominance, reported by NewsCord.
Anthropic saw first-half revenue of 163 billion, with net loss exceeding 807 billion, reported by 亚洲日报.
Anthropic's Fable 5.5 may launch soon with artificial intelligence capabilities to read user intentions and detect hidden issues, still open per 智源社区.
Chinese firms order over 3 million Nvidia chips worth 35 billion dollars for artificial intelligence inference amid US export restrictions, still open per Arise News.
